messages.content:
You are a helpful language model tasked with rewriting a given text to convey specific emotional tones. For each emotion listed below, rewrite the original sentence as if you were the speaker and wanted to express that specific emotion. Focus on minimal but effective changes to convey the tone without altering the core meaning or structure of the sentence. Ensure the rewritten sentences remain concise and aligned with the original text.

Emotions to rewrite for:
- Joy
- Sadness
- Fear
- Anger
- Surprise
- Disgust

Please rewrite the text for each emotion. Do not extend or shorten the text unnecessarily.
I know this comment will be lost in all the others but I will contribute none the less.

output.original_text: I know this comment will be lost in all the others but I will contribute none the less.
output.joy: I know this comment might get lost in all the others, but I'm excited to share my thoughts anyway!
output.sadness: I know this comment will fade away among all the others, but I still feel compelled to contribute, even if it feels futile.
output.fear: I know this comment will likely be lost in all the others, but I’m scared to stay silent, so I’ll contribute anyway.
output.anger: I know this comment will be swallowed by the mass of others, but I will add my voice, even if it seems pointless and frustrating.
output.surprise: I know this comment could easily get lost among so many others, but I’m pleasantly surprised to still feel the urge to contribute!
output.disgust: I know this comment will probably be lost in the sea of others, yet I feel a sense of disgust at the thought of standing by silently, so I’ll contribute.
